score.description: 0-100: the three component scores added up, rounded to 0.1.

label.description: CRITICAL at 90+, HIGH at 70+, MEDIUM at 40+, else LOW.

has_public_poc.description: true when an NVD or CNA exploit reference, a Metasploit module or an ExploitDB entry is found. Never false: null means none of these sources names one.

exploitability.description: From EPSS, CISA KEV and a Metasploit module. max is 60.

impact.description: From the CVSS base score, v3 or else v4. max is 30.

evidence.description: From the count of exploit references in the NVD and CNA records, or 1 when there is none and ExploitDB lists the CVE. max is 10.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
